svg.aria-label: How the litter box is wired to the Raspberry Pi’s GPIO header. The HX711 load cell amplifier takes VCC from pin 2 (5V) and ground from pin 6, sends data (DT) to pin 29 (GPIO 5) and takes its clock (SCK) from pin 31 (GPIO 6). The four 50 kg load cells under the box connect to the HX711’s E+, E-, A+ and A- inputs. The magnetic reed switch on the lid connects to pin 36 (GPIO 16) and ground on pin 34.
svg.text: Pin numbers are the physical header positions.
